about_the_game:
Elevate your city's entertainment scene with the Creator Pack ‘Leisure Venues’. Designed by the community creator ‘Gruny’, this pack transforms your city into a vibrant hub where citizens can unwind, have fun, and enjoy life to the fullest. From delightful dining spots and serene parks to thrilling sports facilities and nightlife venues, this pack has all your citizens need to enjoy their free time.

Included in ‘Leisure Venues’ by ‘Gruny’:

23 Signature Buildings and 7 Parks

Turn your city into the ultimate destination for leisure and entertainment, this pack includes 30 signature buildings to be placed freely in your city. The assets include a diverse array of dining options, modular parks, and various sports facilities. It also includes a cinema complex and cultural attractions like an esports arena, museum, and aquarium.

Signature Buildings:

  • Riverside Grill

  • La Cuillère d'Argent

  • The Lobster Tail

  • SteakHouse
